text:
Hello Ananya,

We completely understand your frustration regarding the delay in receiving your royalties for "Between Two Temples", and we sincerely apologize for the wait. 

As your book has been live for over 28 months, this delay is entirely on us, and we take full responsibility for missing your payout. 

To help us resolve this right away, please confirm that your bank details are correctly linked in your author dashboard. You can also view your detailed royalty breakdown and sales across Amazon India and the BookLeaf Store directly in your dashboard. 

Our team will look into this and get back to you within 48 hours with an update on your pending royalty amount of Rs 2,546.

Warm regards,
BookLeaf Support Team
